servinfo.title: Stall Test
servinfo.ptxt: This test is to check overall performance of A/T and engine by measuring stall speed in D and R ranges. Perform this test only when ATF is at normal operating temperature and its level is adequate.

attention1.ptxt: If you do not select a suitable route and take proper precautions when performing a road test, an accident can occur.

item.ptxt: Select a level road with no traffic to minimize the risk of accident.
Perform the road test with 2 persons, a driver and a tester.

attention4.ptxt: If proper precautions are not taken when performing stall tests, a transaxle failure may result due to an excessive rise in ATF temperature.

item.ptxt: Do not continue running the engine for longer than 5 seconds at stall speed.
After performing a stall test, allow the engine to run it at idle speed for longer than 1 minute before performing another stall test.
Limit the driving speed permissible in road conditions and regulations.
Repeat test 3 times and take average of those data.

s1.ptxt: Connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC.
Select “Data list” mode on scan tool.
Drive vehicle so that ATF temperature reaches normal operating temperature (50 to 80 °C (122 to 176 °F)).

attention3.ptxt: Engine coolant temperature rises when revving engine in P or N range, but ATF temperature does not rise in P or N range.
Drive vehicle to raise ATF temperature.

s1.ptxt: Apply parking brake and block wheels.
Start engine with select lever in P range.
Shift select lever to D range and depress accelerator pedal fully while watching tachometer. Read engine rpm quickly when it has become constant (stall speed).
Release accelerator pedal immediately after stall speed is checked.
In the same way, check stall speed in R range.
Stall speed should be within the following specification.

condition.ptxt: Lower than standard level in both D and R ranges

action.ptxt: Replace torque converter referring to A/T Assembly Reassembly .

condition.ptxt: Higher than standard level in D range

ps.ptxt: Malfunction of line pressure control solenoid valve (Low line pressure)

ptxt.intxref: Valve Body Assembly Removal and Installation

action.ptxt: Check one-way clutch referring to A/T Assembly Reassembly .

condition.ptxt: Higher than standard level in R range

ps.ptxt: Malfunction of line pressure control solenoid valve (Low line pressure)

ptxt.intxref: Valve Body Assembly Removal and Installation

action.ptxt: Check 1st and reverse brake referring to A/T Assembly Inspection and Adjustment and 1st and Reverse Brake Inspection .
